scenarios.name: Read and drive the landing circuit

input.description: route /circuit/explorer with query capability, namespace, scenario, node, row, page, detail; session states signed-in / signed-out; declared sources catalog, details, scenario, session, release, provider-inspection

event.description: events load / click / submit / change / select / seek / toggle dispatch actions navigate, select, session, observe, objective, playback, view, toggle, pane, copy/download, stage-change, refresh

outcome.description: the read returns ui-page.v1 status READ or DEGRADED or a named refusal; each region subcircuit resolves AUTHORED or HELD and testimony lights traversal states

authored.name: Read and drive the landing circuit
authored.description: The landing circuit hosts login, four provider-backed regions and the drill-down flywheel; every behaviour is a declared step, binding or call.

steps.text: route /circuit/explorer with query capability, namespace, scenario, node, row, page, detail; session states signed-in and signed-out; declared sources catalog, details, scenario, session, release, provider-inspection
events load, click, submit, change, select, seek and toggle dispatch navigate, select, session, observe, objective, playback, view, toggle, pane, copy/download, stage-change and refresh
the read returns ui-page.v1 READ or DEGRADED or a named refusal; every region subcircuit resolves AUTHORED or HELD and lights only from declared testimony

scenarios.name: Authenticate an IDE user through private provider boundaries

input.description: route /circuit/login with return target /circuit/explorer (only same-origin /circuit targets admitted); signed-out session; the declared observation input contract; credentials stay in the private host

event.description: submit from the form scope dispatch the session action intents sign-in, sign-out and continue; the transport forwards {identifier, password} to the identity host and the bearer lives only in the HttpOnly __Host-sfx-session cookie

outcome.description: session state signed-in or signed-out; submit status is a closed disposition map - AUTHENTICATION_REJECTED, THROTTLED, LOGIN_INPUT_INVALID, IDENTITY_NOT_CONFIGURED, IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE, IDENTITY_RESPONSE_INVALID, SAME_ORIGIN_JSON_REQUIRED, SESSION_ENDED

authored.name: Authenticate an IDE user through private provider boundaries
authored.description: The login entry is its own circuit; the 17-operation private host composition extends the three declared server providers retained here.

steps.text: one private login input from cli-login-input-provider; only the safe correlation enters the observed circuit
the private identity host resolves the principal, verifies the credential and establishes a session only after successful verification
the scenario returns authenticated, authentication rejected, throttled or identity unavailable without exposing private credentials

scenarios.name: Header region circuit - identity, environment and navigation chrome

input.description: request { contractId: ui-region-request.v1, regionId: header }; region in the declared set; maximum 16384 bytes

event.description: one declared operation ui.region.load; validation runs before load; events load / click / submit dispatch navigate and session intents

outcome.description: AUTHORED with the region candidate and per-asset sha256 digests, or HELD with named findings; session outcome face signed-in / signed-out; never a fallback region

authored.name: Header region circuit - identity, environment and navigation chrome
authored.description: Route /circuit/explorer; environment label from GET /api/circuit/v1/home; release from /healthz. Chrome only, never meaning.

steps.text: route /circuit/explorer; session states signed-in and signed-out; environment label from GET /api/circuit/v1/home and release from /healthz
events load, click and submit dispatch navigate (Home, Explorer) and session intents sign-in, sign-out and continue
the region load is READ or a named refusal; identity dispositions are named and the login submit runs authenticate-ide-user through the identity host

scenarios.name: Left sidebar region circuit - navigate and select a capability

input.description: request { contractId: ui-region-request.v1, regionId: left-sidebar }; one selection model (capability, namespace, scenario); declared sources details and catalog

event.description: events click, submit, change, select and toggle; select on tree items, tabs and rows, navigate on picker submit, pane for splitter resize and collapse, toggle for narrow-window drawers

outcome.description: capability-details.v1 rows in emission order ending capability_navigation; counts, states and badges render as returned, never recomputed; CAPABILITY_NOT_FOUND and CAPABILITY_NOT_SELECTED are named

authored.name: Left sidebar region circuit - navigate and select a capability
authored.description: One selection model serves the tree, the canvas and the row; a selection is state, not evidence.

steps.text: one selection model over capability, namespace and scenario; sources details (navigation rows from read-capability-details) and catalog (picker datalist)
select on tree items, tabs and rows; navigate on picker submit; pane for splitter resize and collapse; toggle for narrow-window drawers
capability-details.v1 rows render in emission order ending capability_navigation; a tree click sets the one selection model and the circuit target selects its row

scenarios.name: Middle region circuit - scenario canvas and execution

input.description: request { contractId: ui-region-request.v1, regionId: middle }; the selected scenario's read-live-scenario-circuit, its declared input contract and the objective text

event.description: events click, submit, change, seek and toggle; actions observe, objective, playback, view, toggle and select

outcome.description: testimony lights admission to completion to return; unobserved branches stay unlit and no endpoint lights before the scenario's own return; execution outcomes are exact declared variants or the defect endpoint

authored.name: Middle region circuit - scenario canvas and execution
authored.description: The viewer draws traversal state and decides nothing; the status bar is chrome carried inside this boundary, not a fifth region.

steps.text: the selected capability's scenario circuit read-live-scenario-circuit; live and replay testimony over the observer stream; the declared input contract and the objective text
observe, objective, playback, view, toggle and select dispatch one admitted run, and replay or view controls re-draw only
received testimony lights admission to completion to return; unobserved branches stay unlit and a replay is a re-draw, never an execution

scenarios.name: Right sidebar region circuit - context, inspection and evidence

input.description: request { contractId: ui-region-request.v1, regionId: right-sidebar }; the Explorer selection and expected snapshot digest; attributed session runs; provider inspection; the declared ui-view.v1 drill-down

event.description: context tabs are local; observe from the bound fields; copy/download for evidence export; stage-change stages a provider change document only; select and seek move timeline steps

outcome.description: run and evidence reads render as returned; a missing session names sign-in and does not submit; an interrupted stream exposes Resume without resubmitting; nothing here applies a change or mints trust

authored.name: Right sidebar region circuit - context, inspection and evidence
authored.description: A reading, never a receipt; component evidence attaches to declared node and edge addresses only.

steps.text: the Explorer selection; attributed session runs; run reads and stream; the declared input contract; provider inspection; the declared ui-view.v1 drill-down
context tabs are local; observe posts from the bound fields; copy/download stages evidence; stage-change stages a change document; select and seek move timeline steps
run and evidence reads render as returned; a provider glyph opens the declared provider view; nothing in this region applies a change or mints trust

scenarios.name: Provider drill-down circuit - provider profile view

input.description: the Explorer selection (capability, namespace, scenario, detail id, expected snapshot digest) bound into the view's declared source inputs by bindViewSelection

event.description: declared events on the profile sections; copy/download and stage-change are the deployed writers-that-write-nothing

outcome.description: ui-view.v1 status READ renders the declared sections; an absent or unreadable view renders its named refusal, never a fallback

authored.name: Provider drill-down circuit - provider profile view
authored.description: The flywheel: the same circuit template instantiated at provider scope, carried by ui-view.v1 and read through the deployed page reader at /circuit/views/<viewId>.

steps.text: the Explorer selection bound into the view's declared source inputs; the subject is chosen by the Explorer and a declaration names no concrete provider
a provider glyph opens the view directly; component selections open declared authority; copy/download stage the exact change document
ui-view.v1 READ renders the declared sections; an absent or unreadable view renders PROVIDER_VIEW_RENDER_FAILED or PROVIDER_VIEW_UNREADABLE, never a fallback

transitions.semanticProgress: login submit and sign-out run the identity circuit through POST /api/circuit/v1/session; the bearer lives only in the HttpOnly __Host-sfx-session cookie
observe submits one capability run and follows that run's own cursor and SSE testimony in the middle region
the objective row admits request-capability-from-objective-v3, switches capability and follows the run
navigate reads the destination for the named path; select sets the one shared selection model and lights the declared target row, never a hidden request
a provider glyph opens its declared view; the drill-down follows returned typed targets, never names, and re-draws the already-loaded traversal model
